english.title: Misrepresentation by employee etc of foreign power relating to unregistered political influence activity
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person who

(A)_[held office in or under]_
(B)_[was an employee or other member of staff of]_

a foreign power, carried out a political influence activity namely **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITY..), in the UK in that capacity, having made a misrepresentation about your activities or the capacity in which you acted when that activity was not registered with the Secretary of State knowing, or having regard to other matters known to you, ought reasonably to have known that you made that misrepresentation
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 72(6) and 80(3) of the National Security Act 2023.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: A defence is available to a person who has taken all steps reasonably practicable to determine whether the activities in question are or are not registered, and having taken such steps, reasonably believes that they are registered (sections 72(7)). A person must demonstrate sufficient evidence to raise an issue with respect of it, and the contrary is not proved beyond reasonable doubt.
